messages:
alex: PSA found `config.yml` with `version: 0.9.0-oracle✨` — parser: 'prophecy not recognized'. :crystal_ball:
riley: lol the oracle token. Did it also predict merge conflicts? :laughing:
sam: there's a folded YAML note that reads like a haiku:
```yaml
note: >
  foretold: the CI will sleep
  include: 'sacrifice one semicolon'
```
ci-bot: pipeline failed - semver parse error: invalid prerelease token 'oracle✨' (config.yml:1).
riley: emoji in prerelease. New policy: emojis require a changelog sonnet and at least one pun. :rofl:
alex: Proposal: auto-map unknown prereleases -> `archived-<token>` and log original token in a metadata field. I can sketch a tiny script.
sam: +1. Also can we ban non-ascii in prereleases? my eyes twitch.
riley: Cookie bribe: I'll help write tests if someone brings cookies tomorrow at 10am. :cookie:
alex: Deal. I'll bring cookies if PR lands. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: issue created #9001: normalize-prerelease-tokens. Assigned to @alex. :robot_face:
sam: Hero.
